essence: Worship, worshipper, worshipped — what difference-course in the unsurpassed? Transition: of whom, by whom effected, who enters? Māyā, not different from consciousness-nonduality, stands as other — alas. All is pure own-experience-nature; vain thought, do not.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of recognition (pratyabhijñā); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at Māyā standing as other without being different. The rasa is the tranquility of non-duality — no worship-difference in the unsurpassed.
